package.description: Find and kill orphaned dev server processes hogging your ports.

en-US.description: Find and kill orphaned dev server processes hogging your ports.
en-US.longDescription: DevKill is a Windows utility that discovers processes listening on ports via native Windows APIs and lets you kill them. It auto-discovers zombie dev servers (Node, .NET, Python, PHP, Vite, and others), shows them in a modern dark Fluent UI, and lets you kill them individually or in bulk. Includes CLI mode (devkill 3000), system tray integration, and auto-refresh.
en-US.name: DevKill
